review.posthog_relevance: Adds a fallback epoch and configuration flag to warehouse connector ingestion, supplying a required bound parameter to the external Decagon API to prevent 400 errors when no prior incremental history exists.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded fallback value and a configuration option for warehouse ingestion. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 establish a default epoch and runtime assignment to satisfy an API requirement, while P1.F2.H2 adds the configuration flag. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse connector reliability.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the supplied observation that this prevents a 400 error; no test assertions or error handling implementation are visible in the provided hunk descriptions. The benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated by executable checks.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.
